blocks.text: When you have a million things to do, charging won’t be one of them. Whether it’s a busy day or a big event, the Galaxy A50 all-day battery lasts up to 35 hours and if you need a boost, get up and running quickly with Fast Charge. 64GB of built-in memory means there's room for all your stuff, from contacts to apps and up to 100,000 photos. Even expand your memory up to 512GB with a microSD card. Get the perfect shot every time with the Ultra Wide Camera and three specialized lenses that let you capture wider photos, shoot in low-light and take share-worthy selfies. Now you can be sure to get the shareworthy photo every time. Flaw Detection intuitively detects when the photo you just took is blurry or if someone’s eyes were closed and then lets you know so you can reshoot while the moment's still right. With a camera that automatically adjusts in low light, your images turn out sharp day or night. Whether you’re at a late-night concert or spending an afternoon at the park, you can capture the moments as you remember them.Featuring a sleek, 6.4" Super AMOLED edge-to-edge screen, the slimly designed Galaxy A50 fits easily into your pocket. Unlock your Galaxy A50 with a simple touch and the in-display fingerprint scanner will recognize you with just one finger.
